question.text: A uniform current is flowing along the length dinfinite, straight. thin. hollow cylinder dradius $R$ The magnetic field $B$ produced at perpendicular distance $d$ from the axis of the cylinder is plotied in a graph. Which of the following figures looks like the plot?

solution.text: $\because$ Magnetic field due to a hollow cylinder of radius $r$ $$ \begin{aligned} B_{\text {inside }} &=0(\text { for } d < r) \\ B_{\text {outside }} &=\frac{\mu_{0}}{2 \pi} \cdot \frac{i}{d}(\text { for } d \geq r) \end{aligned} $$ So, graph between $B$ and $d$.
